content: Common Next.js+Supabase production pitfalls for non-expert solo builders: forgetting to enable Row Level Security (RLS) leaves all data exposed to anyone with the anon key; auth/session handling breaks silently under SSR/multi-tab/mobile-resume causing users to appear logged out; missing timeouts on Supabase calls cause indefinite hangs; failures are often silent (green build, wrong behavior) rather than crashes, making them hard for a non-technical owner to notice.
